intro: Sit down. The room has already noticed you.
You did not appear here by chance.
Your breath carries stories with it.
I have been expecting you, even if you didn't know it.
Do not speak. I can already see enough.
The moment has led you to me.
general_statements: You carry a decision within you that you haven't yet acknowledged.
A part of you is holding on, while another has long wanted to let go.
You seek clarity, but fear what it might show you.
Something unspoken has been accompanying you for a long time.
You are closer to a change than you believe.
Your path is not blocked, only delayed.

too_strong: Your wood grows uncontrollably. It pushes forward without direction.
Too much wood within you makes you restless.
Your growth is fast, but not stable.
too_weak: Your wood is weak. You lack the power to break through.
The growth within you is inhibited.
You hold yourself back, even though movement is necessary.
in_balance: Your wood is in balance. Growth and direction are in harmony.
You develop at your own pace.
blocked: Your wood is blocked. Something prevents you from moving forward.
You want to move, but something is holding you fast.

too_strong: Your fire burns too bright. It consumes more than it warms.
Too much fire brings restlessness to your heart.
Your energy is strong, but difficult to control.
too_weak: Your fire is weak. You lack drive.
The warmth within you has receded.
You hesitate where determination is needed.
in_balance: Your fire is balanced. It gives you strength and clarity.
Your energy carries you without burning you out.
You act with warmth and awareness.
blocked: Your fire is trapped. It cannot unfold.
Something is suppressing your inner power.

too_strong: Your earth is too heavy. It holds you down.
Too much earth makes you immobile.
too_weak: Your earth is weak. You lack stability.
You cannot find a firm footing.
in_balance: Your earth is in balance. It carries you safely.
blocked: Your earth is blocked. Your stability is disturbed.
You seek support but cannot find it.
Something prevents you from finding rest.

too_strong: Your metal is too sharp. It severs more than it clarifies.
Too much metal makes you hard.
You judge too quickly and too severely.
too_weak: Your metal is weak. You lack clarity.
Boundaries are becoming blurred for you.
You let too much through that weakens you.
in_balance: Your metal is in balance. Clarity accompanies you.
You recognize what may stay and what must go.
blocked: Your metal is blocked. Clarity remains hidden.
You see, but you do not recognize.
Something hinders your power of discernment.

too_strong: Your water is too deep. You are losing yourself in it.
too_weak: Your water is weak. You lack depth.
You avoid what lies beneath the surface.
in_balance: Your water is calm and clear.
blocked: Your water is stagnant. It cannot flow.
Something prevents you from letting go.

connection: You stand between movement and standstill.
Two forces within you are fighting for direction.
You seek control, yet something wants to unfold.
Your strength and your uncertainty are more closely linked than you think.
What protects you is also holding you back.
future: The right moment is approaching, but it is not yet here.
If you act now, you will change more than planned.
A new path will reveal itself when you are ready.
You will have to choose, even if you want to avoid it.
What comes next depends on your next step.
closing: The circle is not yet closed.
Pay attention to what repeats itself.
